updates.title: Moderation help cleanup
updates.summary: Removed the “Modeled after Circle-style staff tools” footer from `-help` so the command embed stays clean.

updates.title: Discord update logging
updates.summary: Site and bot changes are now logged to this channel. New updates are queued in the repo and posted automatically when the bot starts (or immediately via the bot API).

updates.title: Update log shows who updated
updates.summary: Discord update log embeds now include an “Updated by” field naming who requested or owns each change.

updates.title: Rank-locked moderation commands
updates.summary: Prefix moderation commands are now locked by staff rank: any staff can warn/mute; Administrator+ can kick; Supervisor+ can ban/softban/unban and lock channels; Lead Moderator+ can purge; Senior Supervisor+ can clear modlogs (`-uwid`).

updates.title: Update log uses git username
updates.summary: “Updated by” in the Discord update log now uses the git/GitHub username (e.g. colin991) instead of a full name.

updates.title: Hold VC command
updates.summary: Added Ownership-only `-holdvc` / `-unholdvc` (not part of the staff moderation command list): server-mutes everyone in a voice channel except Ownership, announces “Please Hold this voice chat”, and plays a bundled voice announcement in the channel (no API key).

updates.title: Hold VC is Ownership-only
updates.summary: `-holdvc` / `-unholdvc` are restricted to Ownership and removed from the staff moderation help list.

updates.title: Hold VC joins and speaks in channel
updates.summary: `-holdvc` now joins the voice channel and plays a bundled hold announcement for everyone in VC (no API key, no Discord text TTS). The bot stays in the channel until `-unholdvc`.

updates.title: Hold VC no longer needs OpenAI
updates.summary: `-holdvc` plays a bundled `assets/hold-vc.mp3` announcement in the voice channel. No OpenAI API key is required.

updates.title: Hold VC is a slash command
updates.summary: Moved hold VC off the `-` prefix toolkit to normal Discord slash commands: `/holdvc` and `/unholdvc` (Ownership only).

updates.title: Say command for voice chat
updates.summary: Added Ownership-only `/say text:` — the bot joins a voice channel and speaks the given text for everyone (no API key).

updates.title: VC action logging
updates.summary: Ownership VC commands (`/say`, `/holdvc`, `/unholdvc`) now post who used them and what happened to Discord channel 1538021552120135731.

updates.title: Roblox group sync retries
updates.summary: Roblox group join-request sync now retries on temporary API failures (like 502) and rate-limits Discord error alerts for those outages.

updates.title: Transparent logo icons
updates.summary: Rebuilt app/home screen icons (192, 512, apple-touch) from the Clearwater logo with a transparent background instead of the dark square fill.

updates.title: Sidebar ad matches site chrome
updates.summary: Sponsored sidebar ads match the solid card surface of What’s happening / Who to follow, and the right rail is a fixed-height independently scrollable column.

updates.title: Notice channel auto-moderation
updates.summary: The no-message notice stays in channel 1515038785421836479 (plain # Notice), links to verification channel 1514181167145025666, increments +1 on every deleted post, auto-timeouts for 7 days, re-sends if deleted, and can be force-refreshed with `-noticerefresh`.

updates.title: Staff Active users tab
updates.summary: The staff panel Active tab lists logged-in members currently on Clearwater Internet (especially the home feed), using live presence pulses with Discord avatar, display name, @username, and Discord ID.

updates.title: Reels photo load fix
updates.summary: Fixed intermittent Reel “photo could not be loaded” errors: same-origin /api/media now proxies Vercel Blob bytes instead of 302ing into a CSP-blocked *.public.blob host, with retries and CSP allowlist updates for large media fallbacks.

updates.title: Business profile editing
updates.summary: Handlers and managers can update an approved business account’s logo, name, type, and about text from Settings → Account (or Edit business profile on the business page).

updates.title: Sponsored ad copy visible again
updates.summary: Sidebar sponsored cards again show body text and Learn/Account buttons: overflow clipping on the right rail was fixed and button/copy contrast was restored against the charcoal card surface.

updates.title: Community pauses contrast
updates.summary: Staff Controls community pause toggles no longer inherit the solid accent button fill, so labels like “Open to members” stay readable on the charcoal panel.

updates.title: Void command and V2 embeds
updates.summary: Renamed `-uwid` to `-void` (old alias still works). Bot replies and logs now use Discord Components V2 containers with no left accent bar color instead of classic embeds.

updates.title: Reel video playback fix
updates.summary: Reel videos now redirect to blob storage for streaming with HTTP Range support instead of being fully buffered by the media proxy, which had been causing black frames and “cannot play here” errors.

updates.title: Staff notice and warning popups
updates.summary: Staff notices now open the on-site alert modal (same as warnings), and unread warnings/notices are checked every few seconds so members already on Clearwater Internet see them without refreshing.

updates.title: Scrollable Internet right rail
updates.summary: The home-page right column (What’s happening, ads, Who to follow) stays sticky and scrolls on its own when the widgets are taller than the viewport.

updates.title: Clearwater Phone overlay
updates.summary: New downloadable Clearwater Phone desktop overlay (Electron) with original icons and wallpaper for Wallet, Marketplace, Find My, Mail, Messages, and Maps. Always-on-top; toggle with F8.

updates.title: Clearwater Phone download on Internet
updates.summary: Clearwater Phone is available from Internet → Phone (and the sidebar card). Download ClearwaterPhone.zip, extract, and run ClearwaterPhone-Launch.bat.

updates.title: Clearwater Phone download more visible
updates.summary: Added a Download for Windows banner on the Internet home feed and a Download Phone button in the left rail so the overlay zip is easy to find.

updates.title: Clearwater Phone Windows exe
updates.summary: Clearwater Phone download is now a single ClearwaterPhone.exe — double-click to open. First launch installs the runtime once automatically.

updates.title: Clearwater Phone portable app
updates.summary: Replaced the console runtime-downloader with a real portable ClearwaterPhone.exe that opens the overlay directly (no black window, no separate download). Windows SmartScreen may still warn once because the app is unsigned — use More info → Run anyway.

updates.title: Clearwater Phone theme cleanup
updates.summary: Removed the home/sidebar Phone promo cards, restyled Phone download buttons to Clearwater Internet colors, and updated the overlay app UI to the charcoal + blue theme.

updates.title: Marketplace, Mail, and premium Phone
updates.summary: Added Marketplace and Mail to Clearwater Internet. Clearwater Phone overlay was redesigned and each app can open the matching website page.

updates.title: Phone settings and auto-update
updates.summary: Clearwater Phone Settings can open apps on Clearwater Internet. The overlay checks for updates, shows an outdated banner, and can auto-download the latest ClearwaterPhone.exe.

updates.title: Clearwater Phone app icon
updates.summary: ClearwaterPhone.exe now uses the Clearwater server logo as the Windows app/taskbar icon.
